verdict.rationale: EDD's enrollment docs describe a remote, credential-based flow: an emailed verification link completes enrollment, and an additional login verification method is set up by text message, phone call, or email. Nothing in the evidence indicates a biometric liveness check, an in-person visit, or a mailed PIN. Missing for 10: explicit documentation ruling out any added identity-proofing step (liveness, mailed PIN, or in-person) for employer accounts, and independent or hands-on corroboration (the transactional portal returned 403 and was not probed).
